blurb: All spirits produced at Yellowfin Distillery are single estate. The definition of single estate can vary but the message is the same. The entire process (fermentation, distillation, filtration, oaking & packaging) should be completed at one establishment. Another characteristic associated with single estate that we find important is the commitment to sourcing raw materials from a specific geographical area.
